title: The Last Signal
content:
FADE IN:

INT. ABANDONED RADIO STATION - NIGHT

Dust motes float in pale moonlight. Ancient equipment lines the walls.

ELENA (30s, worn jacket) sits at a console, headphones on, eyes closed.

STATIC. Then -- a faint, rhythmic BEEP.

Elena's eyes snap open.

ELENA (whispering): That's not interference.

She yanks a logbook from beneath the desk. Flips to a page dated 1987.

CLOSE ON: a waveform diagram. Identical to what she hears now.

She reaches for the transmit key.

FADE TO BLACK.

TITLE: THE LAST SIGNAL
